api_tokens_board_ids.name: api_tokens_board_ids
api_tokens_board_ids.value: "api_tokens"."board_ids" is null or cardinality("api_tokens"."board_ids") between 1 and 100

board_automations_kind_fields.name: board_automations_kind_fields
board_automations_kind_fields.value:
case "board_automations"."kind"::text
    when 'archive_done' then "board_automations"."days" between 1 and 365 and "board_automations"."tag_id" is null and "board_automations"."priority" is null
    when 'tag_stale' then "board_automations"."days" between 1 and 365 and "board_automations"."tag_id" is not null and "board_automations"."priority" is null
    when 'notify_stale' then "board_automations"."days" between 1 and 365 and "board_automations"."tag_id" is null and "board_automations"."priority" is null
    when 'raise_priority' then "board_automations"."days" between 0 and 365 and "board_automations"."priority" is not null and "board_automations"."tag_id" is null
    else false
  end

boards_background_shape.name: boards_background_shape
boards_background_shape.value:
"boards"."background" is null
    or ("boards"."background"->>'kind' = 'color' and "boards"."background"->>'value' ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')
    or ("boards"."background"->>'kind' in ('gradient', 'photo', 'upload') and "boards"."background"->>'value' ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$')

card_comments_imported_author.name: card_comments_imported_author
card_comments_imported_author.value: "card_comments"."imported_author" is null or ("card_comments"."author_id" is null and length("card_comments"."imported_author") between 1 and 100)

card_recurrences_rule_fields.name: card_recurrences_rule_fields
card_recurrences_rule_fields.value:
case "card_recurrences"."rule"::text
    when 'daily' then "card_recurrences"."weekdays" is null and "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" is null
    when 'weekly' then "card_recurrences"."weekdays" is not null and cardinality("card_recurrences"."weekdays") between 1 and 7 and "card_recurrences"."weekdays" <@ '{1,2,3,4,5,6,7}'::smallint[] and "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" is null
    when 'monthly' then "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" is not null and "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" between 1 and 31 and "card_recurrences"."weekdays" is null
    else false
  end

column_rules_kind_fields.name: column_rules_kind_fields
column_rules_kind_fields.value:
case "column_rules"."kind"::text
    when 'apply_tag' then "column_rules"."tag_id" is not null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null
    when 'remove_tag' then "column_rules"."tag_id" is not null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null
    when 'assign_to' then "column_rules"."user_id" is not null and "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null
    when 'set_due' then "column_rules"."due_days" between 0 and 365 and "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null
    else false
  end
